placeResult.name: Dörcher Bier Miraflores
placeResult.description: A restaurant, bar, and craft brewery inspired by Pozuzo — the only Austro-German colony in the world, located in the central jungle of Peru. Dörcher Tap Room is located in the heart of Peru’s most touristic district: Miraflores. Our rooftop offers a friendly terrace with a beautiful view and a cozy atmosphere to enjoy a meal, sip on cocktails, or try a variety of craft beers. Peru is an ancient country with rich culinary diversity, and Dörcher Tap Room is no exception. We offer a sample of Pozucina cuisine alongside iconic Peruvian dishes, a wide selection of classic and signature cocktails, and 13 taps of craft beer — featuring the best Peruvian brews, served straight from the barrel and chilled in a special cold chamber so you can enjoy them the way they’re meant to be. A welcoming environment where great food, exceptional drinks, and warm service come together to deliver a truly unique and unforgettable experience.
